BETA Close X Serco Group PLC has executed share buybacks on June 29 and 30, 2026, purchasing a total of 657,156 ordinary shares at an average price of approximately 223.91 pence per share. Following these transactions, the company's total issued ordinary shares, excluding treasury shares, stand at 981,737,966, with 21,008,048 shares held in treasury. The total number of voting rights, excluding treasury shares, is also 981,737,966 as of June 30, 2026. Disclaimer* Serco Group PLC 30 June 2026 30 June 2026 Legal Entity Identifier: 549300PT2CIHYN5GWJ21 Serco Group plc Transactions in own shares and Total Voting Rights Serco Group plc (the " Company ") announces that, in accordance with the terms of its share buyback programme (the " Programme ") announced on 5 March 2026, it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 2 pence each (" Ordinary Shares ") through RBC Europe Limited. The total number of Ordinary Shares held in treasury is 21,008,048 . The total number of voting rights in the Company, excluding treasury shares as at 30 June 2026 is 981,737,966 . This figure may be used by shareholders (and others with notification obligations) as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in, Company or its Group under the Financial Conduct Authority's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules.
